title: Engineering Practices & Technical Leadership
intro: Engineering-practices interviews (often the staff/senior round) test how you operate, not just what you build. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with code review (the daily practice), then architecture decisions (ADRs — how you record trade-offs), then technical debt (how you manage it without going bankrupt). From there it moves to leadership, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and documentation — the multiplier practices. It closes with team collaboration and scenario-based questions.
